name: yondr
description: Progressive web app to compare different job/relocation options

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ts,assets,serve -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm run dev:ts" "pnpm run dev:assets" "pnpm run dev:serve"
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && . ./.env && test -n "$DEPLOY_TARGET" && rsync -avz --delete dist/ "$DEPLOY_TARGET"
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && . ./.env && test -n "$DEPLOY_TARGET" && rsync -avzn --delete dist/ "$DEPLOY_TARGET"

author: Rylee Corradini
